testsuite.name: hybrid metadata is shared across independent services without lost updates

testcase.name: concurrent writes, fresh reads, unique same-name keys and ownership
public bytes have independent ownership records
concurrent final deletion and dedup admission preserve every successful upload
independent immutable handles reject missing/corrupt bytes and replacement
metadata publication failures retain invisible recoverable intents and never ACK
physical delete failure remains durable and retryable from another worker
empty analytics, missing objects and download authority have explicit outcomes
invalid uploads never create an intent and zero-byte files remain readable
folder and tier filters preserve owner boundaries and stable download URLs
physical analytics count shared bytes once and scope logical ownership
cleanup recommendations and deletion honor age, access and owner
legacy hot-tier decisions only migrate old, infrequently used physical entries
SQL publication and duplicate-key failures reject without partial committed rows
invalid byte receipts and corrupted pending data never become visible
deduplicated and active reads verify full content before acknowledgement
immutable publication needs a confirmed manifest and rejects corrupt metadata
legacy parser rejects public-map corruption and cyclic or unresolved ownership
verified containers reject inconsistent headers and decoded lengths
rollback transport failures preserve the original error and release SQL clients
a deletion waiting on the content lock observes a completed concurrent deletion
legacy aliases retain the original blob after primary deletion and cannot resurrect
unknown legacy references abort the entire import and retain the source
